name: pagination
behavior: A navigation landmark: <nav> with an accessible name ('pagination') containing a list of page links. The current page carries aria-current='page' and is the only item so marked. Previous/next are real links/buttons that become aria-disabled at the ends rather than disappearing, so the control does not reflow. The ellipsis is decorative (aria-hidden) and is accompanied by a visually-hidden 'More pages' label. Every item is a normal tab stop — pagination uses no roving tabindex, because each destination is independently reachable.

parts.note: the list item; no chrome of its own

parts.statesNote: the current page uses interaction-selected / on-interaction-selected and aria-current; it must differ from hover by more than weight

parts.note: stands for the collapsed page range
'Page 3 of 20' — Salt Paginator's compact mode leans on this instead of a full page list

anatomyNotes: Intersection of shadcn Pagination (Pagination/Content/Item/Link/Previous/Next/Ellipsis) and Salt Pagination (Paginator/PageButton/PageRanges ellipsis/CompactPaginator/GoToInput). Salt's compact paginator replaces the page list with a count label and an input — that is a COMPOSITION (input anatomy + count-label), so the registry keeps count-label optional rather than inventing a compact variant axis; the Salt adapter declares the swap. Salt's GoToInput is likewise the input anatomy, not a part here. shadcn renders pages with the button recipe (outline when current, ghost otherwise); the registry states this on the page part in slots instead, so a theme that marks the current page with selected-indicator instead of a fill still conforms.
